check_name: Expected standardized source files are present
analytical_implication: Stage 2 closure requires the validated source-specific output set.

check_name: Output manifest row counts match persisted files
analytical_implication: Manifest counts must be reproducible from persisted standardized files.

check_name: Validated Stage 2E observation count is preserved
analytical_implication: The Stage 2E extraction baseline must remain stable through Stage 2F and Stage 2G.

check_name: Observation identifiers are unique
analytical_implication: Duplicate observation IDs would break source-to-analysis traceability.

check_name: All standardized observations resolve to registered sources
analytical_implication: Every standardized observation must trace to the canonical source registry.

check_name: Standardized files use the locked Stage 2 extraction schema
analytical_implication: A common source-preserving schema is required before Stage 3 harmonization.

check_name: Required standardized fields are populated
analytical_implication: Required identity, semantic, evidence, and traceability fields cannot be blank.

check_name: All standardized quantitative values are numeric
analytical_implication: Stage 3 cannot safely process malformed quantitative values.

check_name: Percentage observations fall within 0-100
analytical_implication: Out-of-range percentages would indicate extraction or standardization error.

check_name: Category bounds are internally ordered
analytical_implication: Distribution brackets must retain a valid numerical ordering.

check_name: Reported metric denominators do not exceed source sample sizes
evidence: No impossible denominators; unresolved metric-specific n=24.
analytical_implication: Blank metric-specific denominators remain missing rather than being inferred.

check_name: Mapped project metrics resolve to the locked Stage 0 dictionary
analytical_implication: Stage 2 must not introduce undeclared project metrics through silent relabelling.

check_name: Ambiguous and source-defined income concepts remain unmapped
analytical_implication: Generic or source-defined net income cannot be relabelled as project gross, receipts, or net operating earnings.

check_name: Mixed fuel-plus-food cost bundles stay outside project operating costs
analytical_implication: Personal food/drink expenditure must not enter project operating-cost totals.

check_name: Driver-reported deduction categories remain separate from realized deductions
analytical_implication: Survey-reported deduction categories cannot substitute for matched transaction evidence.

check_name: Generic working time is not relabelled as online or productive time
analytical_implication: Hourly analysis must preserve the source-reported time-basis caveat.

check_name: Ambiguous daily distance is not treated as total work-related distance
analytical_implication: Fuel and per-km economics cannot silently use ambiguous distance as total work distance.

check_name: Retrospective historical values remain classified as recall
analytical_implication: Recall values must not be interpreted as independent historical survey waves.

check_name: Stage 2 standardized observations contain no analytical transformation
analytical_implication: Inflation, modelling, and analytical transformations belong to later documented stages.

check_name: Comparability remains use-specific rather than globally attached to observations
analytical_implication: The same observation may have different eligibility across analytical uses.

check_name: Stage 2F comparability assessments use valid statuses and traceable observations
analytical_implication: Stage 3 must be able to trace every comparison decision to standardized observations.

check_name: Comparable-with-transformation assessments specify the required transformation
analytical_implication: Later analysis cannot use transformed-comparable evidence without a documented transformation.

check_name: Stage 2F summary reproduces the persisted comparability assessment
analytical_implication: Summary counts must be mechanically reproducible from the assessment table.

check_name: Complete SRC010 income distributions reconcile to 100 percent within rounding tolerance
analytical_implication: Small 99.9/100.1 totals are accepted as one-decimal source rounding, not corrected.

check_name: Unresolved metric-specific denominators remain explicit
evidence: Observations with unresolved metric-specific denominator n=24.
analytical_implication: Analyses requiring respondent counts must exclude or caveat these rows rather than assume the full sample denominator.

check_name: SRC013 internal 62-versus-67 locality discrepancy is preserved
evidence: SRC013 geography values=['Indonesia; source reports 62 and 67 kabupaten/kota in different sections']
analytical_implication: No single locality count may be asserted as certain until the source discrepancy is independently resolved.

check_name: SRC025 companion presentation is not double-counted against SRC017
analytical_implication: Overlapping figures from the same INDEF-PPPI programme must not become independent observations.

check_name: Stage 2 does not manufacture project net operating earnings
analytical_implication: Net operating earnings require a defensible receipts-and-cost chain that Stage 2 does not yet contain.

check_name: Stage 2 reference inputs retain valid provenance and separate evidence roles
analytical_implication: CPI, fuel-price, regulatory, and platform-policy inputs remain reference evidence rather than driver observations.

check_name: Cross-source comparability limitations remain binding
evidence: No Stage 2F comparison is directly comparable without transformation, caveat, contextual restriction, or exclusion.
analytical_implication: Stage 3 and later analysis must honor the use-specific comparability assessment rather than pool all standardized evidence.

check_name: Complete same-observation project unit-economics chain is not falsely asserted
analytical_implication: Stage 4 may analyze available components and scenarios, but must not present an observed gross-to-net chain that the evidence does not contain.

check_name: No blocking extraction-validation failure remains
analytical_implication: Stage 2H may proceed only when Stage 2G has no blocking failure.
